closure_reason: bounded diligent search found only historical/commercial references; no current maintained authority, release, API, or redistribution licence was located
reopen_trigger: written rights-holder confirmation of a current maintained release and redistribution scope
recommendation: close as closed_no_go after the bounded diligent search unless a current rights-holder and written licence emerge

options.recommended: complete bounded diligent search, then close no-go if no current authority or rights evidence is found
options.rights_holder_enquiry: contact Oxford University Press, identified historical authors, or successor rights-holder; permit no payload until written terms
options.substitute: use open rare-disease sources such as Orphanet or Disease Ontology, without representing them as LDDB

evidence.search_scope: public web, bibliographic records, historical descriptions, and source-governance registries
rights_holder_candidates: historical LDDB authors or institutional successor

exit_conditions: written redistribution permission covering intended artefacts
decisions_requested: Confirm whether a current rights-holder or maintained release exists
Provide explicit redistribution permission if a source is identified
Otherwise close the investigation as no-go
panel_role: advisory provenance and diligence review only; cannot grant rights or override no-go
